First, note the given date: 09-10-1101 is in DD-MM-YYYY format → 10 September 1101.  

Subtract 34 weeks and 1 day:  
34 weeks = 34 × 7 = 238 days.  
Add 1 more day → total subtract 239 days.  

1101 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
September 10, 1101 minus 239 days:  

Go back into August 1101:  
September 10 → September 1 is 9 days back (10 - 1 = 9 days).  
239 - 9 = 230 days left to go back from Sep 1.  

August has 31 days: back to August 1 is 31 days (Sep 1 → Aug 1).  
230 - 31 = 199 days left to go back from Aug 1.  

July has 31 days: 199 - 31 = 168 days left from July 1.  
June has 30 days: 168 - 30 = 138 days left from June 1.  
May has 31 days: 138 - 31 = 107 days left from May 1.  
April has 30 days: 107 - 30 = 77 days left from April 1.  
March has 31 days: 77 - 31 = 46 days left from March 1.  
February has 28 days (1101 not leap): 46 - 28 = 18 days left from March 1? Wait, careful:  

We are going backward from April 1:  
From April 1 back to March 1 is 31 days (March has 31).  
We had 77 days left from April 1:  
77 - 31 = 46 days left from March 1.  

From March 1 back to February 1 is 28 days (Feb 1101 has 28).  
46 - 28 = 18 days left from February 1.
